summary: Iteration 95: Comprehensive frontend testing of MoneySSutra expense views redesign. All 13 features tested and passed. Daily view auto-selects today's date (28), Categories sections present in Daily and Weekly, Monthly breakdown cards (Essential/Lifestyle/Wealth Building) and Spending Insights are clickable buttons, Month pill selector syncs correctly, back button returns to List view, mobile responsive layout works without overlapping, text visibility is good (white #FFFFFF text on dark navy #0E1421 background).

issues: Console warning about chart dimensions (-1x-1) from Recharts library - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

context_for_next_testing_agent: All expense view features verified working. Deep navy theme (bg=#0E1421, card=#1A2332) with white text (#FFFFFF, #E2E8F0) provides good contrast. Monthly view has clickable <button> elements for breakdown cards and insights. Month pill selector at bottom syncs with chart bar clicks. Daily view auto-selects today's date on load.
